function validateAuthorization(authorizationHeader, storedLogin, storedPassword)
    local authType, encodedCredentials = authorizationHeader:match("^%s*Basic%s+(.*)$")
    if not authType or not encodedCredentials then return 401, "WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm=\"Restricted\"" end
    
    local decodedCredentials = (require 'base64').decode(encodedCredentials)
    local login, password = decodedCredentials:match("^(.-):(.+)$")
    
    if not login or not password then return 401, "WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm=\"Restricted\"" end
    
    if login == storedLogin and password == storedPassword then
        return nil
    else
        return 401, "WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm=\"Restricted\""
    end
end
